final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.trader_type, s1.cnt, s1.cnt * 1.0 / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.trader_type, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.cnt > s4.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s5
